about: Calendar-quarter income-statement and balance-sheet series for the AI-capex buyers (dashboard slide). Read from SEC XBRL companyfacts downloaded on 2026-11-09; nothing is estimated. capex and fcf are copied from research_quarterly.json (bigtech).
units: USD billion, 3 decimals; ratios in % (interestCoverage in times).

definitions.revenueGrowth: revenue / revenue of the same calendar quarter one year earlier - 1 (%)
definitions.fcf: operating cash flow - cash capex of the quarter (finance-lease principal not deducted)
definitions.interestCoverage: operating income / nonoperating interest expense of the same quarter (times)
definitions.debtRatio: total liabilities / shareholders' equity at quarter end (%); Amazon liabilities = assets - equity

method: Duration items: discrete 3-month fact as reported, otherwise fiscal-YTD differencing (fiscal Q4 = full year - 9 months); where neither exists, YTD through the next quarter minus that quarter's 3-month fact. Instant items: fact dated at the quarter end. Most recently filed fact wins (restatements). A quarter that cannot be derived from tagged facts is left null (never interpolated).
gaps: Meta tags total interest expense (InterestExpenseNonoperating) only for full years. Its quarterly series uses InterestExpenseDebt (interest on notes, finance-lease interest excluded; 2025: 1.090 vs 1.165 total), and the quarters 2024Q1 and 2024Q2 are null because only their combined amount (0.240) is tagged. interestCoverage is null for those two quarters.

Meta.interestExpenseNote: InterestExpenseDebt (interest on notes; finance-lease interest excluded)

ttm_vs_financials.note: quarters use InterestExpenseDebt (interest on notes; finance-lease interest excluded); the TTM in research_financials.json starts from the full-year total
